mapper.select: SELECT id, dag_instance_id, node_id, attempt_no, format, object_key, checksum, created_at, CASE status WHEN 10 THEN 'CREATING' WHEN 20 THEN 'STAGED' WHEN 30 THEN 'AVAILABLE' WHEN 40 THEN 'ORPHANED' WHEN 50 THEN 'DELETING' WHEN 60 THEN 'DELETED' END AS status_enum, CASE WHEN storage_type = 'OBJECT_STORAGE' THEN 'OBJECT_STORAGE' WHEN storage_type = 'FILE_GDB' THEN 'FILE_GDB' WHEN storage_type = 'POSTGIS' THEN 'POSTGIS' ELSE NULL END AS storage_type_enum FROM sr_dag_artifact WHERE id = #{artifactId} AND status = 30
